typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		MO as string,
		INV as string,
		{T D} as string,
		{S D} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> 127FlatFileSource
127FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		INV as string,
		MO as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TradeDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SettleDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INV,
		MO,
		Load_Date = LoadDate,
		TradeDate = {T D},
		SettleDate = {S D}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
